title: At the Beach
hook: 一家人去海边玩水、堆沙堡，把猪爸爸埋在沙里，回家时把他忘在了沙滩上。

cells.a: They are going to the beach for the day.

cells.q: Why can't George catch the ball?
cells.a: Because he is too little to catch it well.
cells.cn: 因为他太小了，接不好球。

cells.a: He is wearing water-wings so he can play in the sea.
cells.cn: 他戴着游泳圈，好下海玩水。

cells.q: What did Peppa say to Daddy?
cells.a: She said, “Daddy, I love being at the beach.”
cells.cn: 她说：“爸爸，我太喜欢在海边了。”

cells.q: What did the children ask Daddy Pig?
cells.a: They asked if they can bury him in the sand.
cells.cn: 他们问能不能把他埋在沙子里。

cells.a: They are burying Daddy Pig in the sand.
cells.cn: 他们正把猪爸爸埋进沙子里。

cells.q: What did Daddy Pig decide to do?
cells.a: He decided to have a little sleep on the beach.
cells.cn: 他决定在沙滩上睡一小觉。

cells.q: What did Mummy Pig say as they left?
cells.a: She said not to leave any of their things behind.
They forgot the hat, and they also forgot Daddy Pig!
cells.cn: 他们忘了帽子，还把猪爸爸也忘了！

opener: Today I watched Peppa Pig. This episode is “At the Beach”.
ending: In the end, they forget Daddy Pig on the beach. My favourite part is ______.
